The skill file contains incorrect commands for bypass authentication. Please make these corrections:

INCORRECT COMMANDS TO REMOVE:
- enable netlogin
- configure netlogin bypass-authentication enable
- configure netlogin bypass-client-type IoT
- configure netlogin bypass-client-type Legacy

CORRECT COMMAND TO USE:
configure fabric attach zero-touch-client <client> [vlan [[<vlan_name>|<vlan_id>] [nsi <nsi>|isid <isid>] {priority [<priority> | dot1p]} {bypass-netlogin [on | off]} {enable | disable} | none] | enable | disable]

IMPORTANT DETAILS:
- When bypass-netlogin option is enabled, a ZTC client bypasses Netlogin authentication on the port even if Netlogin is enabled
- LLDP communicates ZTC client info to Netlogin
- An FDB entry is installed for the client to allow normal traffic forwarding
- No netlogin session is associated for bypassed clients
- ZTC client ports must be in "mac-based-vlans" mode for this feature

INCLUDE THESE CLI COMMANDS:

1. Show fabric attach elements:
debug lldp show fabric attach database

Example output from EXOS 34.1:
